look: the Tracks page's own interactive 3D model (src/three/trackScene.js, public/tracks-3d/models/<slug>.json) at its opening view, drawn headless at 600 x 338 CSS px, device scale 2; the same shading list SectionHeatCard hands the model
shadingSource: site-pace.ts: resolveHeatSections(anchorsForPack(pack, venueAnchors), sectionObservationsFromLaps(pack, full race, median), { basis: field_times }), coloured with inkGoldDiverging; sections with no comparison stay the pale lane
centreline: site t (the outline's arc parameter the anchors use) -> the model's centreline through the model file's baked map.u, projected with the opening view's camera; x, y are shares of the image width and height

brands-hatch-indy.call: Indy (1.944 km): FF1600 2019-2020 (laps 50.1-51.3 s) and the four GB3 2022 Friday sessions, re-measured by the life-stats ledger from field lap speeds (1.207 mi a lap). OSM loop 1929 m; start/finish OSM node 1825805766.

brands-hatch-gp.call: Grand Prix (3.916 km): GB3 2021 R1 and 2022 R7 (qualifying 1:21.6 / 1:19.3) and the 2020 Champion of Brands British GT support meeting (1:36.1). OSM loop 3900 m; start/finish OSM node 1825805766 (shared with Indy).

silverstone-national.call: National (2.64 km): Walter Hayes Trophy 2020 (ledger track_silverstone_national; FF1600 laps 65.8-69.4 s fit the 2.64 km National). OSM loop 2638 m via the National Pit Straight.

silverstone-international.call: International (2.979 km): BRSCC FF1600 2020, the result book prints the layout (ledger track_silverstone_international). Route Abbey, Farm, Village, the Link, Becketts, Stowe, Vale, Club (official layout; research notes item 7); OSM loop 2979 m, start/finish on the Hamilton Straight (the Wing).

silverstone-gp.call: Grand Prix: GB3 2021 R2/R6 and 2022 R2 qualifying 1:54.5-2:09.8 fit only the 5.891 km GP; ledger track id track_silverstone_gp. OSM loop: Chapel Curve onto the Hangar Straight (candidate 0), Vale, start/finish on the Hamilton Straight (OSM node 13036050130).

oulton-park-international.call: International (4.332 km) for all three meetings: the BRSCC programme for 18 July 2020 prints "International Circuit (2.69 miles / 4.33 km)"; GB3 2021-22 qualifying 1:32.6 / 1:34.4 fit the International (research notes item 8). OSM loop: with Britten's and Hislop's chicanes (both in place well before 2020); OSM's older unchicaned alignment (way 27299256, source Yahoo) and Britten's bypass forbidden.

snetterton-300.call: 300 circuit (4.779 km): GB3 2021 and 2022 (qualifying 2:01.0 wet / 1:42.5); research notes item 8.

donington-park-gp.call: Grand Prix (4.020 km): all four GB3 rounds 2021-22 (qualifying 1:23.9-1:25.7); research notes item 8. Resurfaced for 2023 and new Fogarty Esses kerbs in 2024: surface and kerbs only.

spa-francorchamps-gp.call: Grand Prix (7.004 km): GB3 2021-22 and Euroformula Open 2023 (qualifying 2:11.7-2:20.4). Run-off works at Raidillon, La Source, Les Combes, Blanchimont and Stavelot between his 2021 and 2022 races; the track line is unchanged (research notes item 11). OSM loop through Speaker's Corner (the car layout), not OSM's 'Moto layout' chicane.

castle-combe-full.call: Full circuit with the two 1999 chicanes, Bobbies and the Esses (2.977 km): CCRC Formula Ford 1600, July and August 2020. Resurfaced 2015 and partly 2018, surface only; corner renames since 2020 (Hammerdown to Howard's Way, Tower to Gooch's) are names only (research notes item 4). OSM loop through both chicane ways, 'Bobbies' and 'The Esses'.

circuit-of-the-americas-gp.call: Grand Prix circuit, 20 turns (5.513 km): SCCA Hoosier Super Tour, February 2019. 2022-24 repaving, concrete slabs and verge changes moved no corner (research notes table). OSM loop without the MotoGP long-lap loop and the short-course links. Start/finish at OSM's 'finish' node (the timing line), as at the Algarve; OSM also has an older 'start-finish' node about 300 m away.

cadwell-park-full.call: Full circuit (3.520 km): Formula Ford 1600, August 2020. No layout change found since the mid-2000s resurfacing (research notes table). OSM's smooth line onto the start straight, not the unnamed 92 m spur beside it that ends in a square corner.

algarve-gp.call: Grand Prix circuit (4.653 km): Euroformula Open, April 2023. 2024 kerb and run-off works (T4, T8, T14, T15) came after his race; no layout change (research notes table). OSM loop through the named Curva da Torre VIP and Curva Galp, not OSM's unnamed cut-throughs; 4652.9 m against 4653 m official. Start/finish at OSM's 'finish' node (the timing line); OSM's separate 'start' node marks the grid.

road-atlanta-full.call: Full course, 12 turns (4.088 km): SCCA Hoosier Super Tour and F1600 Championship Series, March and April 2019. The Turn 4 chicane went in 2017 and the last full repave was 2007, both before (research notes table). OSM's main line (4095 m), not its 'Motorcycle Turn 12' or two other unnamed bike-course ways.

watkins-glen-long.call: Long course with the Boot, 3.370 mi (5.423 km), through the Inner Loop (Bus Stop): F1600 Championship Series, May 2019 (official timing sheet prints 3.370 mi; research notes item 5). The 2024 Bus Stop rework was kerbs and paving only.

career.centreline: t is the model's own lap fraction from its start/finish (identity map: these venues have no site outline)
